transports.provenance: Observational-only ClaudeBot/1.0 JA4 family. Anthropic official bots.json lists 216.73.216.0/22 as Anthropic bot egress. Independent telemetry supplies three source-corroborated examples inside that prefix: Anubis relayd telemetry for 216.73.216.114 with the full ClaudeBot/1.0 User-Agent and JA4, plus ELLIO passive records for 216.73.217.37 and 216.73.217.73 with the same User-Agent and JA4. The ELLIO records have different JA3 values, so only the stable JA4 is promoted here. No HTTP/2 SETTINGS fingerprint is independently verified; do not borrow GPTBot H2 merely because the JA4 collides.
